# goenv-allowlist.txt -- existing offenders of the `goenv` class test: a child
# `go` command that inherits the caller's environment. One row:
# file:line kind date reason.
#
# The file only shrinks. An entry that names no offender on the tree is refused
# (`delete the stale row; the allowlist only shrinks`), so fixing a site means
# deleting its row in the same change, and a new row parks nothing. A row
# allows ONE offender of its kind in its file and is matched by file and kind,
# never by line, so a merge that shifts lines in a listed file does not turn
# dev red.
#
# It is empty, and that is the point: every site in the tree was fixed when the
# rule landed (2026-09-18, after GOFLAGS=-json made `nova-review mutate` report
# red=2 green=0 on a range that is red=1 green=1). The allowed shape is
# cmd.Env = goenv.Clean(os.Environ()).
